documentation.projectOverview: Arabic Medical Symptom Triage Assistant is a software system for arabic-speaking patients in lebanon in the Healthcare Technology domain. Reduces unnecessary ER visits and routes patients to the right specialist
documentation.problemStatement: Lebanese patients often lack guidance on symptom urgency and which specialist to consult before visiting a clinic.

nonFunctionalRequirements.title: Usability
nonFunctionalRequirements.description: The interface should be clear and require no external training for a first-time user.
nonFunctionalRequirements.measurableTarget: Proposed acceptance target: a first-time user completes the primary task without external help.
nonFunctionalRequirements.verificationMethod: Usability walkthrough with a representative user.

nonFunctionalRequirements.title: Reliability
nonFunctionalRequirements.description: The system should degrade gracefully (clear error message, no crash) when a dependent service is unavailable.
nonFunctionalRequirements.measurableTarget: Proposed acceptance target: 0 unhandled exceptions surfaced to the user during a dependency outage.

nonFunctionalRequirements.title: Performance
nonFunctionalRequirements.description: Common user actions should complete within an acceptable response time.
nonFunctionalRequirements.measurableTarget: Proposed acceptance target: p95 response time below 3 seconds under normal load.
nonFunctionalRequirements.verificationMethod: Load test against the primary endpoint.

nonFunctionalRequirements.title: Maintainability
nonFunctionalRequirements.description: The codebase should separate UI, services, data access, and any AI/ML component into distinct layers.
nonFunctionalRequirements.measurableTarget: Proposed acceptance target: no direct database access from UI code.
nonFunctionalRequirements.verificationMethod: Code review against the layering rule.

nonFunctionalRequirements.title: Auditability
nonFunctionalRequirements.description: Security-relevant actions (login, authorization failures, escalations) should be logged with enough context to investigate later.
nonFunctionalRequirements.measurableTarget: Proposed acceptance target: every authorization failure produces a log entry with actor id and timestamp.
nonFunctionalRequirements.verificationMethod: Log review after a simulated authorization failure.

nonFunctionalRequirements.title: Recoverability
nonFunctionalRequirements.description: Persisted data should be recoverable after an unexpected outage without silent data loss.
nonFunctionalRequirements.measurableTarget: Proposed acceptance target: no committed transaction is lost after a simulated crash.

nonFunctionalRequirements.title: AI provider failure handling
nonFunctionalRequirements.description: When the configured AI/NLP provider is unavailable or times out, the system shall degrade to a clear fallback message instead of failing silently.
nonFunctionalRequirements.measurableTarget: Proposed acceptance target: 100% of provider timeouts surface a user-facing fallback message within the configured timeout.
nonFunctionalRequirements.verificationMethod: Simulate a provider timeout and confirm fallback behavior.

nonFunctionalRequirements.title: Response confidence handling
nonFunctionalRequirements.description: Responses produced with confidence below the configured threshold shall be treated as uncertain (clarification/escalation) rather than presented as a confident answer.
nonFunctionalRequirements.measurableTarget: Proposed acceptance target: 100% of below-threshold responses trigger clarification/escalation instead of a direct answer.
nonFunctionalRequirements.verificationMethod: Test with a query engineered to produce low confidence.

nonFunctionalRequirements.title: Unsafe-output prevention
nonFunctionalRequirements.description: AI-generated content shall be screened before being shown to an actor to reduce the risk of unsafe or inappropriate output.
nonFunctionalRequirements.measurableTarget: Proposed acceptance target: no flagged unsafe response reaches the actor unmodified.

architecture.explanation: Arabic Medical Symptom Triage Assistant follows a layered architecture. ASP.NET Core Razor Pages renders the actor-facing screens for Arabic-speaking patients in Lebanon. ASP.NET Core Razor Pages implements the core feature set: Arabic Medical Symptom Triage Assistant Core Capability, Authenticate and Authorize Users. AI/NLP service (unresolved, unresolved) handles the AI/NLP-dependent steps of query processing. PostgreSQL persists the entities described in this document. Authentication uses ASP.NET Core Identity with cookie authentication.

securityAndPrivacy.requirement: Passwords must be stored using a strong one-way hash (e.g. bcrypt/argon2), never in plain text.
securityAndPrivacy.rationale: Protects credentials if the database is compromised.

securityAndPrivacy.requirement: Every data-access operation must verify the requesting actor owns or is authorized for the target record.
All user-submitted input must be validated server-side, not only client-side.
Sessions must expire after a configured inactivity period.
securityAndPrivacy.rationale: Limits exposure from an unattended, authenticated device.

securityAndPrivacy.requirement: API keys and connection strings must be stored in environment configuration, never committed to source control.
User-submitted text must be screened before being forwarded to the AI provider, and any instruction-like content in it must never override system instructions.
securityAndPrivacy.rationale: Prevents prompt-injection attacks from manipulating the AI component.

securityAndPrivacy.requirement: Requests to the AI/query-processing endpoint must be rate-limited per actor.
securityAndPrivacy.rationale: Protects against abuse and provider quota exhaustion.

securityAndPrivacy.requirement: Personal data included in a query must not be forwarded to an external AI provider beyond what is strictly required to answer it.
securityAndPrivacy.rationale: Limits exposure of personal data to third parties.
